veranderings.rede: The adverb 'deurmekaar' is written as one word.

veranderings.blok: Elke stof bly wat hy was
veranderings.voor: nog duidelik sien as stukke, korrels of lae
veranderings.na: nog duidelik as stukke, korrels of lae sien
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the infinitive 'sien' goes to the end, after the 'as' phrase; this sits outside the protected opening.
AWS comma: 'en' joins a second clause with its own subject and verb ('die olie lê').

veranderings.voor: Nat beton word hard en deeg
veranderings.na: Nat beton word hard, en deeg
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.na: op die maniere in hierdie les
veranderings.rede: 'hierdie maniere' points to methods the learner has not met yet; the reference is unclear at this point.

veranderings.voor: Dit kan hulle grootte of kleur wees, of dat een sink.
veranderings.na: Die verskil kan in hulle grootte of kleur lê, of daarin dat een van hulle sink.
veranderings.rede: The original breaks the parallel structure ('grootte ... wees, of dat een sink') and leaves a bare 'een'; same meaning, clearer construction.

veranderings.voor: die gaatjies bly op die filter
veranderings.na: die gaatjies, bly op die filter
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates its verb from the main verb 'bly' (AWS); study text only, not the protected definition.

veranderings.voor: Jy kan olie wat bo-op water lê ook afgooi
veranderings.na: Jy kan ook olie wat bo-op water lê, afgooi
veranderings.rede: 'ook' belongs before the object it adds, and a comma after the relative clause separates 'lê' from 'afgooi'.

vlae.teks: twee of meer verskillende stowwe of materiale wat saam gemeng is
vlae.rede: AWS writes the separable compound 'saammeng' as 'saamgemeng'; the study sentence repeats the protected shared definition word for word, so it is not changed here (see beskerm_bedenkings).

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: mengsel - "Twee of meer verskillende stowwe of materiale wat saam gemeng is."
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'saam gemeng' should be one word, 'saamgemeng' (the verb is 'saammeng'); a decision for the whole subject-grade's shared definition, and the study text in 'Wat is 'n mengsel?' should follow it.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: filtreer - "... vaste stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter."
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: An AWS comma after 'gaatjies' would separate the relative clause from the main verb 'bly', as the shared 'oorgiet' definition already does after 'lê'; minor, for whoever owns the shared wording.
